gecko_mapping.source: Owned candidate root omni modules/DownloadCore.sys.mjs, Download.start lines378..428
gecko_mapping.retry: A failed/cancelled download becomes active with a new startTime on the same Download object. This is treated as a new badge arrival. Paused resumption does not steal another selection. This maps engine events; it is not a native Arc retry trajectory proof.
gecko_mapping.multiple_windows: Each DownloadsCommon view receives the same event. The first remaining source owner processes it, and the process-level badge publishes selection to all windows. Public and private pools remain separate.
